snippet.title: Stage 1 Boss Preview - Nullschwert
snippet.description:
A responsible leader and a blade connoisseur. In her arrogance, she seeks to stop its incursion all by herself. Prefers rapid, subduing attacks.

Wishlist Nullschwert on Steam.
